bluePosts.title: Blue Post Reply: Level 48 and above missions will increase gold reward
paras: Blizzard explained: Forever intentionally removed the EXP to Coin mechanism for quests at full level, as it encouraged players to accumulate quests until level 60, or even to level up by grinding monsters instead of handing in quests. However, only about 25% of quests in the original version directly awarded Coins, resulting in less Coin revenue than expected when approaching level 60. To this end, Coins will be added to most quests at level 48 and above through hotfixes, including quests that originally did not give Coins. This change has been released with the hotfix on November 10.

bluePosts.author: community Manager
bluePosts.title: November 10: PvP Rules Server Camp Balance Adjustment
paras: Blizzard said that PvP rule servers require two camps to be evenly matched. The current ratio of the largest difference between regions is about 55 to 45, which is still not as expected, so the character creation mechanism has been adjusted: instead of a snapshot of the overall camp status of PvP rule servers in each region, the goal is to be as close as possible to 50 to 50. In the short term, it will be increasingly difficult for the larger party to create new characters, currently tribes in North American PvP rule servers, and alliances in European role playing PvP; as the population moves, the restricted party may switch. Blizzard acknowledges that it can be frustrating not to choose which faction to play at the moment, but believes it is necessary to ensure long-term health, especially in the early stages of the game when guilds and opposing relationships are just forming.

bluePosts.title: Combating the gold coin trade: temporary economic restraint mechanisms
paras: The official launch of a new mechanism to combat real currency transactions. Accounts suspected of selling or receiving illegal coins may be temporarily restricted from trading, mail, guild banks and auction houses to prevent suspicious coins from continuing to circulate and allow time for investigation. Normal accounts will not be affected; restrictions will be automatically lifted after investigation. If violations are confirmed, they will be punished by accounts. Misjudgments may occur during the adjustment of the new system. Temporary restrictions will not leave a permanent penalty record. If validated, the mechanism will be used in other versions of World of Warcraft as well.

paras: The development team introduced the subsequent polishing of Skyborne's appearance style, the re-creation of HD Druid form, and the addition of standard definition character models for players to choose from.

bluePosts.author: Blizzard employees
bluePosts.title: New Battlefield: Dark Spear Islands
paras: Official introduction of the new 15-on-15 battlefield Dark Spear Islands: Both sides compete for strongholds, seize flags, and receive reputation rewards from their respective factions.

bluePosts.author: Blizzard employees
bluePosts.title: Introduction to Player Battle Progress System
paras: The official introduction of the eternal version of the player's battle progress: around honor, rank points, season goals and the original military rank, battlefield, battle missions, weekly missions and equipment upgrades can be rewarded, and finally can get the title of high-level warlord, marshal and so on.

bluePosts.author: community Manager
bluePosts.title: October 6th Maintenance Supplemental Repair
paras: The reboot also fixed two problems: occasional drops in connection while riding in elevators or transportation; and possible errors when joining or leaving guilds.

bluePosts.author: community Manager
bluePosts.title: Oct. 6 Short Server Maintenance
paras: The beta realm is restarted to apply a number of priority fixes, including one for the disappearance of quest items that should have been restocked in boxes; online players will see a prompt before logging off.

bluePosts.author: community Manager
bluePosts.title: October 5th Short server maintenance
paras: To improve service quality, the beta realm restarts after a few minutes to apply fixes; online players see a countdown prompt that closes a few minutes before reopening.

bluePosts.author: community Manager
bluePosts.title: Normorrigan fault fixed
paras: Player feedback that the Nomorrigan Instance Dungeon could not proceed normally was fixed that afternoon.

bluePosts.author: community Manager
bluePosts.title: Australia player login pop-up issue fixed
paras: The issue that caused Australia testers to see an error when logging in has been fixed.

bluePosts.author: community Manager
bluePosts.title: October 2: Additional changes to warriors
paras: A number of Warrior changes were added to the new build of the day, and development notes were added: Critical hit bonus increased to 100%(up from 75%); Fixed a mistake in Dual Weapon Specialization that gave hit bonus to both the main hand and the secondary hand, and adjusted the Rage talent accordingly-increased utility and choice in the first part of the Rage Line, no longer required to point Rage to get Flurry in the second part, added several talents, removed several talents; Protection talent repositioned so that warriors who do not use shields can hit mid-tier.

bluePosts.author: community Manager
bluePosts.title: October 1st the beta realm login problem
paras: Officials have noticed that some testers are unable to log in to the beta realm and are working to fix it as soon as possible.

bluePosts.author: community Manager
bluePosts.title: Australia Player Login Pop-up Issues
paras: After the new build went live, Australia players received an error message saying "social features are locked" when logging in. There is no such restriction. Fixed on October 4.

bluePosts.author: community Manager
bluePosts.title: October 1st known issues
paras: Known issues added this week: forward swing effects and sound effects for each cast in a row don't appear until the end of the previous cast; monsters can parry and block from behind when close to monsters; client installs are too large; switching handles resets edit mode layout; some debuffs don't generate hatred; hit bonuses for dual weapon specialization incorrectly affect the main hand; penalty aura uses target's spell power, etc.

bluePosts.author: community Manager
bluePosts.title: October 1 Development Notes
paras: Level cap increased to level 30. Added Dungeon Digging Field: Wetlands (levels 26-31), Razor Heights and Aldaman. Improved visibility in rainy days, temporarily removed ray-tracing shadow options. Added Barber Shop to Darnassus and Thunder Bluff. Campfire no longer deals damage to players below level 5. All nine classes have been modified, with Warrior changing the most.(Critical Strike Rage, Fury, and Defense talent reshuffled); Druids removed Tiger Rage and added two Cat Form talents. Dungeon quest bonus EXP reduced by 50%, Honor item price increased by approximately 50%, Honor cap increased to 25000.

bluePosts.author: community Manager
bluePosts.title: The beta realm will distribute Legacy Points uniformly
paras: In order to facilitate the testing of the Inheritance System, 16 Inheritance Points would be distributed to all testers in a certain week. There was no need to practice multiple classes or repeatedly clear dungeons. After distribution, they would be kept until the end of the test.

bluePosts.author: community Manager
bluePosts.title: Strike Script with Cash Deal
paras: The official continues to block accounts that prohibit script swiping gold coins, as well as accounts that buy or knowingly receive illegal gold coins. After the official server is launched, the same will be done. In the game, a reminder will pop up when trading with strangers: unknown gold coins may cause accounts to be blocked.

bluePosts.author: community Manager
bluePosts.title: October 1st update maintenance
paras: The beta realm will be updated in about 45 minutes.

bluePosts.author: Blizzard employees
bluePosts.title: Official Podcast Issue 2
paras: The second issue of the official podcast was launched. Several designers chatted with the anchor guests about professional design and quick leveling.

bluePosts.author: community Manager
bluePosts.title: Updated maintenance notice on October 1st
paras: The beta realm went offline for maintenance the next morning (Pacific Time) and reopened a few hours later with a new build, raising the level cap to level 30.

bluePosts.author: Blizzard employees
bluePosts.title: Class Depth Analysis: Priest and Warrior
paras: Officially released Priest and Warrior design analysis, including new and adjusted base skills, Priest racial skills, Warrior rage and stance changes, and six specialized talent changes.

bluePosts.author: community Manager
bluePosts.title: Career Thematic Follow-up Plan
paras: Officials say the plan is to gradually cover all occupations, but sorting out topics will take time and the design may continue to change during testing.

bluePosts.author: community Manager
bluePosts.title: Sniper shot description corrected
paras: Sniper Shot was incorrectly described in Hunter Analysis article. Corrected: It is a 31st talent in the marksmanship department. Requires a strong attack aura first. Cast for 4 seconds. Cooldown for 15 seconds. Damage is higher than aimed shot. Base range is 45 yards. Increases range of the next 3 shots by 10 yards.

bluePosts.author: community Manager
bluePosts.title: Career panel discussion: supplementary reply on punctuation
paras: Community manager adds response to class discussion: punctuation helps clarity, and players can use it according to their habits.

bluePosts.author: community Manager
bluePosts.title: Career panel discussion: Responding to dash usage
paras: The community manager responded to player comments about punctuation, saying he had been using dashes for years and thanked players for their interest in the topic.

bluePosts.author: Blizzard employees
bluePosts.title: In-depth analysis of occupations: Hunter and Druid
paras: Hunter and Druid design analysis released, introducing talent adjustments, signature skills and new gameplay for these two classes.

bluePosts.author: community Manager
bluePosts.title: Morgory's Kyle quest line
paras: Players hoping to revive the Mogore "Kyle Lost" quest line, officials say is being processed; an October 1 update has been added back to the quest.

bluePosts.author: community Manager
bluePosts.title: About Buying Gold Coins
paras: The official reiterated that cash transactions are prohibited: In addition to banning sellers, more buyers 'accounts will be processed in the future, including taking back illegal gold coins. Serious accounts will be closed. Please be cautious when accepting gifts from strangers and unilateral transactions.

bluePosts.author: community Manager
bluePosts.title: Server queuing problem fixed
paras: The investigation found a problem that caused the queue to be abnormally full, which has been fixed.

bluePosts.author: community Manager
bluePosts.title: September 25 Server restart
paras: To resolve stability issues, the beta realm will shut down and restart within minutes, with short maintenance times.

bluePosts.author: Blizzard employees
bluePosts.title: Call for podcast topics
paras: The next podcast will focus on career design, and developers are welcome to post topics they want to hear about in the future.

bluePosts.author: community Manager
bluePosts.title: September 25 Server issues
paras: Officials are following up on server issues affecting some testers, and fixing them is likely to require a server restart that day.

bluePosts.author: Blizzard employees
bluePosts.title: Role Name Violation Handling
paras: The beta realm characters were reviewed individually by the development team and forced to change their names if they violated naming rules; players whose names violated the code of conduct severely were disqualified from testing.

bluePosts.author: community Manager
bluePosts.title: September 24 known problem
paras: New known issues are mainly focused on Cooldown Manager: Cooldowns for some curses, healing stones, arcane strikes, pet skills, and weapon enchantments are untraceable. In addition, partying or changing parties may transfer players to another world instance; Stormwind minimap displays anomalies. Two quest issues (Escorts running too fast, EXP too much for a quest) will be fixed in the next build.

bluePosts.author: community Manager
bluePosts.title: September 24 Development Notes
paras: Fixed issues such as not playing forward shake when casting spells, unable to cast spells during Camp Fire buff, etc. Fixed a memory leak that caused performance to gradually decrease. Reset talent for only 1 silver during beta. Druid multiple healing skills can critical hit, rage base damage increased by about 50%, Mangle renamed Primal Bite; Paladin Holy Strike damage increased by all levels, cooldown reduced to 10 seconds; Mage Fire talent buff duration increased; Shaman Lightning Arrow high level damage increased.

bluePosts.author: community Manager
bluePosts.title: September 24 Maintenance in progress
paras: The beta realm goes offline for maintenance and deployment of new builds, which is expected to take at least a few hours, with full development notes and known issues released later.

bluePosts.author: Blizzard employees
bluePosts.title: Official Podcast Issue 1
paras: The first issue of the official podcast was launched, and the designer talked with the two anchors about the test launch.

bluePosts.author: community Manager
bluePosts.title: Enhanced weather effects are about to be tested
paras: More intense weather effects are about to be added to the beta realm.

bluePosts.author: Blizzard employees
bluePosts.title: Introduction to the Legacy System
paras: Inheritance System: A growth system for account sharing. Complete challenges to obtain inheritance points, which are used to unlock character abilities and appearance rewards.

bluePosts.author: community Manager
bluePosts.title: Auto Shot casting time problem
paras: Hunter Auto Shot and Wand Shot were supposed to have 0.5 seconds cast time before they were fired, but now due to a glitch that is significantly shorter, players take less time to stand and shoot than designed; build fix expected next week.

bluePosts.author: community Manager
bluePosts.title: September 22 Client Update
paras: Beta client updated to 1.60.1.69977 to fix Mac display and stability issues, as well as issues with the controller when selecting corners and picking quests items. Next full week update on September 24.

bluePosts.author: Blizzard employees
bluePosts.title: New Race: Skyborne
paras: Skyborne: The starting area is level 1-12 and Wind Island. When building a corner, you can choose to join a tribe or alliance.

bluePosts.author: community Manager
bluePosts.title: Thanks for the Apple Computer Problem Report
paras: Official thanks to players for submitting detailed reports of Apple computer graphics problems, multiple analyses and fixes are underway.

bluePosts.author: Blizzard employees
bluePosts.title: Introduction to ethnic and occupational combinations
paras: Officially introduced optional races, class combinations, and adjusted racial talents, including new options for old races and new races Skyborne.

bluePosts.author: community Manager
bluePosts.title: "Role name already exists" question follow-up
paras: Officials are gathering information to confirm the cause of the problem and whether the fix is correct.

bluePosts.author: community Manager
bluePosts.title: Character name already exists: plan to restart the beta realm
paras: The community manager said in the discussion of the role name anomaly that the team was considering restarting the beta realm server that day.

bluePosts.author: community Manager
bluePosts.title: "Role name already exists" problem
paras: Some players can no longer enter the character after disconnection, prompt character name already exists. Please attach the character name and the exact time of the last normal game and disconnection when reporting, so as to facilitate checking logs.

bluePosts.author: community Manager
bluePosts.title: Skyborne Mission Stuck Fixed
paras: An event on a Skyborne quest on Windy Island will get stuck halfway through, causing it to be unable to continue; the fix from the previous few days did not take effect, but this time it has been fixed and the player can complete the quest.

bluePosts.author: Blizzard employees
bluePosts.title: double naming convention
paras: Each character can take two names, complete double names are unique in the same region, so the first part of the name can be repeated with others.

bluePosts.author: Blizzard employees
bluePosts.title: Choose rules over servers
paras: Instead of picking from a list of servers, players choose a rule: normal, PvP, role-playing, or hardcore, each of which is a large overall community; hardcore is only available after launch.

bluePosts.author: community Manager
bluePosts.title: Can not start the game processing method
paras: The official explanation is that the test forum is open to all subscribers; and share personal experience: when the game cannot be updated, you can delete the data folder in the game directory and let Battle. net repair again.

bluePosts.author: community Manager
bluePosts.title: Graphics Requirements
paras: Remind players: After the official launch, some of the old graphics card architecture far below the minimum configuration will no longer be supported. See the official graphics card requirements for details.

bluePosts.author: community Manager
bluePosts.title: Login issues with multiple game authorizations
paras: You can't select an account when there are multiple authorizations under the same Battle. net account. It is recommended to create a test account on the account management page to see if you can select it when logging in.

bluePosts.author: community Manager
bluePosts.title: known problem supplement
paras: Added known issues: Cooldown manager not yet complete; armor bonuses for consumables and buffs are amplified by bear form; spell queue window is closed when queuing for next attack ability; missiles with full damage are fired when channeling arcane missiles; duration of low level resurrection weakness is incorrect.

bluePosts.author: community Manager
bluePosts.title: Known issues at the time of test initiation
paras: Known issues at launch: Barber Chair error, the beta realm friends feature turned off, minimaps may be out of screen, some supply box items could not be submitted, and several quest issues, most of which will be fixed in the next build.

bluePosts.author: Blizzard employees
bluePosts.title: Testing officially begins.
paras: The test runs from September 17 to October 21; you can sign up or purchase a designated gift package to qualify. The official launch time is November 4 (3 p.m. Pacific Time).

bluePosts.author: community Manager
bluePosts.title: Test Forum Open
paras: A dedicated test discussion area has been opened.

bluePosts.author: community Manager
bluePosts.title: The beta realm gradually opens
paras: The beta realm is gradually letting people in.

bluePosts.author: community Manager
bluePosts.title: the beta realm is about to open
paras: A large number of players are waiting to enter the test, and officials are dealing with the last few questions, which will soon be open.

bluePosts.author: community Manager
bluePosts.title: Nine new dungeon levels
paras: Correction: Crodock Fortress is suitable for levels 40-45. The nine new dungeons are: Lord's Hall 13-18, Lordaeron Ruins 15-20, Digging Ground: Wetlands 24-29, Dalaran City 28-33, Sunken City 35-40, Crodock Fortress 40-45, Okaz Prison 48-53, Blackthroat Fortress 55-60, and Elementalist Platform 58-60.

bluePosts.author: community Manager
bluePosts.title: Eternal Edition announced at Blizzard Carnival
paras: The official summary post collects the published contents of the eternal edition.

bluePosts.author: community Manager
bluePosts.title: General Discussion Area Open
paras: Eternal version of the comprehensive discussion area open, please read the forum code of conduct before posting.
